Embeddings map text to vectors; similar meanings land close together.
日本語のテキストも少し含めます。中文也可以。

Retrieval systems split documents into passages, embed each passage once, and store the vectors in an index. At query time the question is embedded with the same model and the nearest passages by cosine similarity are returned, which is why the embedding must be deterministic and normalised.
